name: Eclairs, Caramel with chocolate center
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Liquid glucose, Whey powder (Milk), Hydrogenated palm oil, Maltodextrin, Cocoa powder (1.5%), Humectant (Sorbitol, Glycerol), Emulsifiers (Mono and di glycerides of fatty acids, Soya lecithin), iodized salt (Salt, Potassium iodate), Stabiliser (Gum acacia), Colour (Sulphite ammonia caramel), Flavouring.
